name: SprayMap
summary:
SprayMap Quest brings the SprayMap irrigation design tool to Meta Quest as a large, resizable 2D window.

• Satellite map of any property: draw the property line and zone outlines
• Auto design: turn zone outlines into heads, nozzles, valves and pipe, then run a design check
• Nozzle catalog with manufacturer charts (Rain Bird, Hunter and more): GPM, radius, arc and precipitation rate
• Spray arcs you can see, adjust and aim on the map
• Drip zones, pipe routing around the house and hardscape, sleeves
• Val
